title: Quadratic pair linearity tester
statement: For $n\ge 0$, choose independent uniform vectors $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The four-position nonadaptive tester queries an oracle at the vector addresses $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, leaves its fourth position unanswered, and accepts exactly when the three returned values $a,b,c$ satisfy $a+b=c$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$; if any of the first three answers is absent, it rejects.
hypotheses_covered: The tester uses four query positions
The seed is a pair of vectors in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ sampled uniformly
